decisions.diagnosis: zero_outage removed genuine near-zero counts during the March 2021 NSW floods; the counter kept recording scattered bikes in both directions.
decisions.evidence: Site totals 13/43/2 on 18-20 Mar vs 69 on 17 Mar; neighbouring counters at the same junction (sites 201/202) show 11-35 then 3/0 on 20 Mar, and site 122 had 0 on 20-21 Mar; single bikes recorded throughout the flagged stretches.

decisions.diagnosis: Westbound zeros on a very wet day were real low riding, not an outage.
decisions.evidence: Eastbound recorded only 8 all day on 24 Aug; sites 201/202/122 had 5/12/9 vs 77/97/55 the day before; westbound resumed normally at 07:15 on 25 Aug.

decisions.diagnosis: zero_outage removed true near-zero counts during the March 2022 floods.
decisions.evidence: Site 200 totals 12 and 5; sites 201/202 had 7/13 and 2/5 vs 38/58 a week earlier, and they also show long zero runs at the same times.

decisions.diagnosis: Zeros during the early-July 2022 Sydney flood event reflect no riding; all three counters at this junction show the same near-zero pattern with isolated bikes either side.
decisions.evidence: Site 200 totals 14/1/0/4; sites 201/202 had 4/12, 0/2, 0/0, 2/5 vs 62/88 the week before; single bikes on 2 Jul 00:30 appear on both 200 and 202.

decisions.diagnosis: Westbound zeros from late morning 29 Apr to 09:15 30 Apr coincide with near-zero riding at the neighbouring counters on a wet day.
decisions.evidence: Eastbound recorded about 2 bikes in the same window; sites 201/202 had 9/9 on 29 Apr vs 63/119 a week earlier, and site 202 also has a zero run then.

summary: Single Metrocount piezo (counter 180) on Settlers Walk with two stable directions, one record per slot and no doubling or channel issues; levels track the adjacent NW Tway counters (sites 201/202) throughout, including the 2021 lockdown rise. Most zero_outage fixes are fine or immaterial (e.g. 2025-10-20 is a genuine outage shared with sites 201/202, and the counter is offline 2026-03-19 to 2026-08-13), but on five flood/heavy-rain spells the removed zeros were real near-zero riding and are restored. Other short zero stretches (2021-11-21, 2021-11-26, 2024-04-05, 2024-11-29/30, 2025-08-20/21, 2025-09-10) are left as automatically fixed since neighbours suggest a few bikes were missed.
